surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-page libadwaita preferences dialog with standard rows for theme, word wrap, line numbers, and the optional minimap.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Rows stay vertically stacked and remain usable without horizontal scrolling.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Standard shortcuts window grouped into file, tab, search, and app actions.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Shortcut groups continue stacking in reading order as width tightens.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-window editor shell with a header bar, a runtime-inserted search bar above the tabs, per-tab banners for ongoing file state, optional minimaps inside tab content, a tabbed workspace, and a bottom status bar.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Header actions stay reachable while the search rows stack above the tabs, per-tab banners stay above editor content, and the minimap remains a narrow fixed strip when enabled without taking over the layout.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Centered window title reflects the selected tab title and subtitle while search, banners, and status chrome are added outside the title area.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The title truncates naturally before it displaces primary header-bar actions.
